categories.main_business_segments: KeePer Technical Laboratory Co., Ltd. operates two main business segments: (1) the 'KeePer Products and Related Business,' which develops, outsources manufacturing, and sells car coating chemicals and related professional tools mainly to gas stations, car dealers, and used car dealers; and (2) the 'KeePer LABO Operation Business,' which runs directly managed and franchised specialty stores providing car coating and car wash services directly to consumers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies center on proprietary car coating chemicals (notably glass-based coatings) and advanced application techniques that do not require polishing or damaging the original paint. Product development is conducted in collaboration with Germany's SONAX, leveraging unique molecular structures for high durability and aesthetic enhancement. Training and certification systems ensure high and consistent application quality across all service locations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: KeePer serves two primary customer groups: (1) B2B clients such as gas stations (especially 'KeePer Pro Shops'), new and used car dealers, and car shops, and (2) B2C end-users through its KeePer LABO stores. The company is expanding its presence in the new car market, with its coatings adopted as genuine products by major automakers and dealers (e.g., Subaru, Toyota, Honda, Mitsubishi, Volvo, Mercedes-Benz).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Japan, with a nationwide network of over 6,600 KeePer Pro Shops and 156 KeePer LABO stores (as of June 2025). It has begun overseas expansion, with its first KeePer LABO store in Singapore and growing presence in Taiwan. Sales to overseas car dealers and distributors are also being pursued.
categories.supply_chain_position: KeePer operates both upstream and downstream in the supply chain: upstream as a developer and supplier of car coating chemicals and tools to service providers, and downstream as a direct service provider to end-users through its own and franchised stores. It also provides training and certification, integrating product, service, and know-how.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the KeePer brand in both the aftermarket and new car markets, accelerating store openings, and strengthening support for franchisees and dealers. R&D focuses on developing high-performance, environmentally friendly coatings (e.g., eliminating PFAS), collaborating with SONAX, and extending applications beyond cars (e.g., mobile devices, home cleaning). Sustainability, digitalization, and human capital development are also emphasized.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through the sale of car coating chemicals and related products to B2B clients, direct provision of car coating and washing services to consumers at KeePer LABO stores, and franchise fees. The company also earns from training and certification programs, and is expanding into new product categories and markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: KeePer claims a unique position by integrating product development, wholesale, direct retail, and technical training, with no direct competitor offering the same comprehensive model. In individual segments, it competes with other car coating chemical manufacturers, car wash chains, and service providers, but differentiates itself through brand strength, technical certification, and high repeat rates.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the fiscal year ending June 2025, KeePer reported record sales of 23.1 billion yen (approx. $150 million), up 12.2% year-on-year, with operating profit of 7.1 billion yen and net profit of 4.9 billion yen. The company has demonstrated strong, consistent double-digit growth in sales and profits over the past several years and forecasts continued double-digit growth for FY2026.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KeePer emphasizes delivering 'astonishing cleanliness' and long-lasting beauty for vehicles through high-performance, proprietary chemicals and certified application techniques. Its value proposition is built on high customer satisfaction (repeat rate ~85%), consistent quality across a vast network, and a strong, trusted brand. The company also highlights environmental initiatives, technical training, and expanding applications beyond automotive.
